observations: Compared Vegeta's folded arms, red scouter, narrow visible eye and slightly open mouth with the printed scan. Green/gold armor, orange gloves, tall hair and red cloud/rock backdrop are retained. Fine facial lines are limited by the small original. No new zoom or confirmed mismatch.

Bulma retains the round open eyes, small open mouth, crossed arm and pointing finger, navy clothing, white collar and tan interior rails. Hands connect to the correct arms. Fine finger details are small in the original; no confirmed mismatch.
Bulma's close-up retains the blue visible eye, closed smile, green scouter and raised finger. Scouter/eyebrow overlap and the original tight framing are preserved. No new crop or confirmed mismatch.

Chi-Chi leans toward Baba with clasped hands and an open mouth; Baba retains narrow eyes, purple hair and hat, with the crystal ball at lower left. Orange clothing and interior background agree. Small fingers remain limited by the original scan.

The ensemble and crystal ball retain their arrangement, including Roshi, Oolong, Baba, Bulma, Chi-Chi, Ox-King and the small animal behind Roshi. Bulma remains serious and looking toward the ball. The original upper-head crop is inherited. Small background expressions are unresolved at scan resolution.

Gohan and Krillin retain wide startled eyes, tiny pupils, open mouths, visible teeth, sweat, hands at shoulders and the chest emblem. Orange/blue clothing and the bright yellow speed-line backdrop match the scene. No confirmed pose or expression mismatch.

The dinosaur retains the close-up profile, large eye, open jaws, pointed teeth, tongue and two saliva streaks, against red/yellow horizontal motion lines. The upper head and right edge retain the source crop. No confirmed mismatch.

Vegeta retains the clenched foreground glove, bared teeth, narrow eyes, forehead scratches, dark-blue suit and gold armor shoulder. Blue speed-line background and original close framing are preserved. No new zoom.

Krillin retains the airborne side kick, foreground boot sole, raised fist, open shouting mouth and bent rear leg. Orange gi, blue wristband and vertical glowing columns match. The original right boot crop is inherited; small eye detail is limited.

Yamcha leans forward with his eyes shut and hands lowered while Chiaotzu hangs behind his shoulder with a surprised mouth. Red gi, green/yellow clothing, insignia, black cap, tiled ground and palms agree. Both characters' visible limbs remain connected.

Goku retains the stern sideways gaze, closed small mouth, black hair, orange gi and dark undershirt with a light collar edge. The original chest-up crop and dark blue backdrop remain. No confirmed mismatch.

Yamcha's backward glance, open mouth, scars and two defensive hands match the printed pose. Red sleeveless gi, blue wristbands and trees against a blue sky remain. Fine fingertips in the original are small; no confirmed extra limb or expression change.

Tien retains the frontal slight smile, open third eye, inward lower-eye gaze and white shoulder cloth beside the glowing column. The previously approved isolated lower-eye correction is retained as a separate layer. No additional facial regeneration or zoom.

Yamcha and the back-facing opponent retain the crossed-arm fighting pose, open mouth, red clothing, black belts and opposing stance. Hands attach to the correct bodies; palms and tiled courtyard remain. The original opponent's face is obscured and is not certified.

Piccolo retains the overhead viewpoint, two spread hands, white cape/turban, purple gi, brown shoes and branching electrical effect above rocky ground. Both arms and feet remain visible. The small original face is partly obscured by effects, so fine facial fidelity is unresolved.

The landscape retains grassy slopes, distant trees, twin mountain forms and yellow scouter-style diagram/arrow. This card has no character anatomy or expression. Retained modern landscape detail is preserved without a new crop.

Goku retains the tightly foreshortened two-hand pose, narrow eyes and focused inward gaze. Thumb, nails and fingers remain attached to the appropriate palms. Orange/blue clothing and blue motion background are preserved; the original tight crop is inherited.

King Kai retains round glasses, a closed downturned mouth, antennae, whiskers and clenched fists at both sides. Black/gold/red robe and purple backdrop agree. Eyes are hidden by glasses and are not treated as verified visible detail.

Roshi retains the leaning pose, open shouting mouth with tongue/teeth, white mustache/beard, glasses, green shirt and lowered visible hand. The pink radial background matches. Eyes remain obscured by glasses; original edge crops are inherited.

The colliding blue and purple beams, circular energy flare and layered rock pillars match the original composition. No characters appear. The richer retained shading does not alter beam direction or terrain arrangement.

The Great Ape face retains red eyes, lowered brows, broad muzzle, nostrils and the small sweat mark at the left temple. Dark fur and tight facial crop match the source. No new zoom or added expression.
Vegeta retains the inward narrow gaze, asymmetric upward smirk, visible teeth and blue/white neckline. The face fills the original frame and remains a close-up. No confirmed expression mismatch.

Saibaimen retains the diving close-up, open red mouth, red eyes, creased head and clawed arms against blue diagonal speed lines. Its green segmented body and original top/right crop are retained. Level/PUR 1 and eleven stages were compared separately.

Saibaimen retains the overhead diving pose, open mouth, red eyes, dark torso, segmented limbs and claws against sky/clouds. The original head/arm edge crops are inherited. Level/PUR 2 and stage values match the original.

Saibaimen retains the airborne full-body pose, spread clawed arms, bent knee, extended rear foot and toothy grin over the sloping green hill. All source-visible limbs remain. Fine teeth are small in the scan. Level/PUR 3 and stages match.

Saibaimen retains the wide crouch, raised rear claw, large foreground claws, bared teeth and red eyes against the exploding orange rocks. Both legs and arms remain connected and visible. The final level/PUR 4 glyphs and original stage values were checked after correcting the draft numeral.

Piccolo and Goku retain the facing profiles and closed friendly smiles, with Piccolo's turban/white clothing and Goku's orange gi. The muted rocky backdrop and source crop remain. The small watermarked scan limits fine pupil comparison.
